source_window.resource_title: Target-specific INSPIRE WMS GetMap portrayal window around verified Forge Cottage point
source_window.data_date: Official HM Land Registry INSPIRE dataset/view-service documentation accessed 2026-10-03; dataset is updated monthly; target WMS response not retrieved
source_window.license: UK Open Government Licence (OGL) for INSPIRE Index Polygons

field_evidence.dataset_semantics: HM Land Registry states that INSPIRE Index Polygons is an open-source dataset containing the locations of freehold registered property in England and Wales; each polygon shows the position and indicative extent of a registered property and has a Land Registry-INSPIRE ID that relates to a registered title.
field_evidence.view_service: The official data.gov.uk record lists an INSPIRE View Service (WMS) for the INSPIRE Index Polygons dataset.
field_evidence.target_basis: Forge Cottage has the verified Planning Data point POINT (0.910196 51.073494). Converted to EPSG:27700 this is approximately E=603968.556, N=134491.689; the attempted WMS window is a 200 metre square centred on that point.
field_evidence.transport_result: The exact official bbox-scoped WMS GetMap request was attempted, but this transport could not retrieve the target-specific image response and returned no target feature or identifier.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: A WMS portrayal image is not itself machine-readable canonical parcel geometry or a title identifier. Without a retrieved target-specific registered-title polygon/feature record, no canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is promoted; spatial binding/materialization remains local OpenCode work.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. HM Land Registry's official INSPIRE WMS view service was queried with a new bbox-scoped GetMap window centred on the verified Forge Cottage location, but this transport could not retrieve the target-specific response. A WMS portrayal also does not itself supply a machine-readable canonical parcel ID/geometry. Local OpenCode/GIS must retrieve and bind the exact target registered-title/index polygon feature or another authoritative target parcel/title polygon; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The method was materially changed from Planning Data JSON spatial filters to HM Land Registry's official INSPIRE WMS portrayal service using a target-specific EPSG:27700 bbox. The exact GetMap window is public/no-login and previously unused, but this transport could not retrieve its response. Even if rendered, WMS is a portrayal service and does not by itself provide a machine-readable canonical parcel geometry/title identifier suitable for promotion. No canonical parcel geometry is asserted and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
